item.title: Coconut Oil Jet Fuel Matches Kerosene's Efficiency in Engine Tests
item.description:
📝 Carbon dioxide concentrations in the exhaust stayed level with pure kerosene across all blends tested. In terms of fuel efficiency, the biofuel blends required more fuel to produce the same amount of thrust. 8% more fuel than pure kerosene, while the ethanol-based version consumed about 19.
🔗 Read more: https://studyfinds.com/coconut-oil-jet-fuel-matches-kerosenes-efficiency-in-engine-tests/

item.title: Amiga-Inspired AROS Goes Bare Metal on Raspberry Pi
item.description:
📝 AROS has already been ported to a number of platforms. AROS developers are making sure that Amiga legacy isn’t stuck on any given hardware, so they never have to let it go. We have featured AROS once before, thought it’s been a while.
